description: Standalone VOICE-OVER generator — DESTINATION = an audio FILE on the user's disk (mp3), downloaded into a tidy folder, billed at the SITE price (per character). Needs a PAID plan (no free audio). Use it for narration, ads, IVR, video voice-overs to download — never placed into a page. Pass the script in `text`, plus a voice id and language from list_voice_models (a default voice is picked if you omit it). If it says still rendering, run again with the SAME settings to pick it up (no double charge). DEFAULT when the user names NO model: elevenlabs-multilingual-v2 with the Roger voice.

dry_run.description: PREVIEW: shows the exact site price and generates NOTHING (0 credit).

language.description: Optional language code from list_voice_models (e.g. 'en-US', 'fr'). Required for some models (Kokoro).

model.description: Optional voice model id from list_voice_models, e.g. "minimax-speech-hd". If omitted, defaults to elevenlabs-multilingual-v2 (Roger voice).

out_dir.description: Folder to download the mp3 into (default 'distribea-voice'). Never overwrites.

project_dir.description: Absolute path of the project root (default: current directory).

text.description: The exact words the voice should read.

voice.description: Optional voice id from list_voice_models. If omitted with ElevenLabs, defaults to the Roger voice; other models fall back to their first voice.

name: generate_voice
title: Generate a voice-over (text to speech) with a chosen voice
